role_definitions.ROOT_EXPORT: Suggested stable Root API endpoint; this is an overlay recommendation, not a changed Lean visibility guarantee.
role_definitions.ROOT_INTERNAL_LEMMA: Root proof support that downstream deltas should avoid importing directly.
role_definitions.INTERMEDIATE_DELTA_CANDIDATE: Varela/local intermediate theorem or structure layered on Root imports.
role_definitions.TARGET_DELTA_CANDIDATE: Target-paper local theorem planned after Root/intermediate imports.
role_definitions.AUDIT_ONLY: Audit surface, not a mathematical dependency API.

source_policy: Only source-explicit module imports and existing formalization/verification records are indexed. No theorem dependency extraction or compilation was performed.
